mapper.select: SELECT to_state FROM punch_import_state_event WHERE punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY sequence_number DESC, punch_import_state_event_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT punch_import_file_id AS file_id, stored_object_ref AS object_ref, original_filename AS filename, content_sha256 AS sha256, template_version, field_contract_digest FROM punch_import_file WHERE punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId}

SELECT punch_import_precheck_id AS precheck_id, normalization_attempt_id AS attempt_id, precheck_token_digest AS token_digest, expires_at, total_count, valid_count, blocking_count FROM punch_import_precheck WHERE punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, punch_import_precheck_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT punch_import_row_id AS row_id, `row_number` AS row_number, raw_values_json, stable_fingerprint, blocking_issue_count FROM punch_import_row WHERE punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY `row_number`, punch_import_row_id
